subject: Temple of Fiends
text: A treasure chest in the small southwest room of the Temple of Fiends contains a Cap.

evidence.quote:
Open up the Treasure Chest to find a
Cap, which is a nice helmet Armor for a White/Black Mage (if none of those
are in your party, give to a Black Belt or Thief), and be sure to equip it
(it does not work otherwise).

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: A treasure chest in the northwest room of the Temple of Fiends contains a Heal Potion.

evidence.quote:
Two Treasure Chests here
contain a Heal Potion and a Cabin (even better than a Tent!).

subject: Temple of Fiends
text: A treasure chest in the northwest room of the Temple of Fiends contains a Cabin.

evidence.quote:
Two Treasure Chests here
contain a Heal Potion and a Cabin (even better than a Tent!).

subject: Treasure Rooms
text: Two of the treasure rooms in the Temple of Fiends are locked.

evidence.quote:
Now you will
be ready to backtrack to the central chamber of the dungeon as the other two
Treasure Rooms are locked (just like the ones in Coneria were!).

subject: Garland
text: Garland has 106 HP, awards 250 Gold, and yields 130 Exp.

subject: Garland
text: Against Garland, have every character attack while Black Mage or Red Mage casts Fire or Lit, and White Mage cures injured party members.

evidence.quote:
1) attack with every
character (except Black Mage/Red Mage who should use Fire/Lit to weaken
him), 2) White Mages can Cure someone if Garland gets lucky enough to land a
few hits on the same person

subject: Princess Sara
text: Talking to Princess Sara after defeating Garland transports the party back to Castle Coneria.

evidence.quote:
Upon defeating him, step forward to pass the bats to talk to Princess Sara!
She will somehow magically transport you back to the castle

subject: King of Coneria
text: Speaking to the King after rescuing Sara prompts him to order his workmen to construct a bridge to the main continent.

evidence.quote:
speak to the King.  He will be so overjoyed at your rescue effort that he
will get his workmen to construct a bridge to the main continent!

subject: Princess Sara
text: Princess Sara gives the Light Warriors a Lute as a reward for rescuing her.

evidence.quote:
Sara will show her undying gratitude to the Light Warriors by
bestowing a fabulous gift upon them!  Gold?  Jewels? Her hand in marriage?
NO!  You get an old, beat up, barely holding together LUTE!

subject: Bridge
text: From the bridge north of Coneria, follow the coast to the left past a port into the forest, go west along the river, and then head northeast through the forest to reach Matoya's Cave.

evidence.quote:
Head along the coast here (to your left) to pass a port and enter a forest.
Turn west to go along the river, followed by heading northeast to go through
the thick forest to find a cave!

subject: Broom
text: A broom on the left side of Matoya's Cave provides the reversed hint TCELES B HSUP.

evidence.quote:
Upon entering, head left to find a walking and talking Broom who has this
little tidbit for you: "....TCELES B HSUP   A magic spell?"

subject: Matoya's Cave
text: Matoya's Cave contains a treasure chest with a Pure Potion.

evidence.quote:
three treasure Chests (one Pure Potion, two
Heal Potions), and a witch named Matoya.

subject: Matoya's Cave
text: Matoya's Cave contains two treasure chests containing Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
three treasure Chests (one Pure Potion, two
Heal Potions), and a witch named Matoya.

subject: Matoya
text: Talking to Matoya reveals that she is blind without her Crystal.

evidence.quote:
Talk to her to learn that she is
blind without her CRYSTAL

subject: Matoya's Cave
text: To reach Pravoka from Matoya's Cave, backtrack southwest, turn east past the second stream in the river, head east through the desert and wide forest, cross a brief plain, and follow the next forest south to the port town.

evidence.quote:
Backtrack to the southwest, turn east after you pass the second
stream in the river, and then continue east through the desert to enter a
forest.  Continue east across this wide expanse of forest to enter a plain
briefly before trekking into another forest where your party should start
off in a southern direction.  You will come across a port town, which you
should enter immediately.

subject: Pravoka Inn
text: Staying at the Pravoka Inn to restore HP and spell charges costs 50 Gold.

evidence.quote: If you need to fill up your Hit Points/Spell Charges, enter the Inn and shell out 50 Gold Pieces.

subject: Pirate
text: Talking to Pirate Captain Bikke initiates a battle against 9 Pirates, each having 6 HP and giving 40 Gold and 40 Exp.

evidence.quote:
His name is Bikke and he happens to be a Pirate Captain, but
he is also rather cowardly so he will sic his entire Pirate Crew on you!...H.P.: 6

Gold: 40

Exp.: 40

WOW!  NINE OF THE WEAKEST GUYS YOU CAN IMAGINE!

subject: Pirate
text: During the Pirate battle, players should spread attacks, cast Fire or Lit with the Black Mage, and have the White Mage or Red Mage cast Cure if necessary.

evidence.quote:
have everyone attack, having Black Mage use Fire
or Lit if you want to assure a Pirate dies at the Black Mage's hands (as
opposed to risking it on his weapon).  Spread your attacks out so the
attacks will not be wasted, and just cut them down one by one.  Also note
that White Mage or Red Mage should use Cure if they gang up on an ally

subject: Bikke
text: Speaking to Bikke again after defeating his pirate crew grants the party the Pirate Ship.

evidence.quote:
talk to Bikke again to
gain the use of his Pirate Ship

subject: Dark
text: The spells Dark and Tmpr are bugged and do not function properly, so they should not be purchased.

evidence.quote:
Note that Dark and Tmpr spells are both bugged and do
not work as they should, so do not purchase them.
